data.name: Surplus EAT Allocation
data.description: Surplus EAT Allocation is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, a Helldiver squad gets 2 free uses of the EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank support weapon per mission.
data.effect: Grants two free uses of the Expendable Anti-Tank (EAT) Stratagem per mission; enough to grant a full squad one single-use rocket launcher each, provided squad members employ the proper equipment distribution protocol.
